summary: Verified A- / A+ font-size control in TryOut exam (/student/exam/<id>) on desktop 1920x1080 and mobile 390x844 using long-question seed TEST_IT31_LONG_5a276a. 18/18 behavioural assertions passed: increase steps 100→115→130→150 (A+ disabled at 150%), decrease 150→130→115→100→90 (A- disabled at 90%), body visibly grows via CSS zoom (820x1852 at 100% → 820x3828 at 150%), no horizontal page overflow at 150% on either viewport (sw===cw=1920 / 390), header stays visible (y=0, h=56), localStorage.exam_font_step persists across next question and page reload (value='4'), clicking the last answer option at 150% keeps exam-root.scrollTop===0 and header.y<5 on both desktop and mobile (iteration_31 regression intact). Mobile sticky bar: '4 poin · Pilihan Ganda' span has display:none (hidden <sm), bar height=53px (no wrap). FontSizeControl testids font-size-control / font-size-decrease / font-size-value / font-size-increase all present and correctly disabled at bounds. HOWEVER, found one functional bug in default initial value when localStorage is empty.

ui_bugs.issue: Default initial font step is 90% (step 0) instead of the specified 100% (step 1) when localStorage.exam_font_step is empty. Root cause: `Number(localStorage.getItem('exam_font_step'))` returns 0 when the item is null, and 0 passes `Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v < FONT_STEPS.length`, so the fallback-to-1 branch is never hit. First-time users / users on a fresh device therefore see question text at 90% by default, which violates the spec 'font-size-value (default 100%)' and makes A- appear disabled on first entry.

action_items: Fix default fontStep initializer in /app/frontend/src/pages/student/TryoutEngine.js (line ~46-49). Suggested fix: `const raw = localStorage.getItem('exam_font_step'); const v = raw == null ? NaN : Number(raw); setFontStep(Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v < FONT_STEPS.length ? v : 1);` — or wrap with `raw !== null && Number.isInteger(v) ...`. Current code treats missing key as 0 because Number(null)===0.
After fix, re-verify: new student (clear localStorage) opening /student/exam/<id> sees font-size-value='100%', A- enabled, A+ enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: TryoutEngine.js L46-49: `Number(localStorage.getItem(k))` of a null key equals 0 which incorrectly passes the integer-range guard and sets fontStep=0 (90%) instead of the documented 100% default. One-line fix needed.

FontSizeControl in ExamParts.jsx uses CSS `zoom` on exam-question-body (L229). `zoom` is non-standard (works in Chromium/WebKit but ignored by Firefox < v126); consider `transform: scale(...)` with `transform-origin` or a CSS variable driving `font-size` for stricter cross-browser support. Not blocking for Chrome/Android target.

FontSizeControl buttons A- / A+ are plain <button> with aria-label; good. The percent display span has data-testid but no aria-live, so screen readers won't announce changes. Minor accessibility improvement.

The sticky bar's '{q.points} poin · {TYPE_LABEL[q.type]}' span has `hidden sm:inline` — correct for mobile. No testid though; if main agent wants to automate meta visibility it could add data-testid='question-meta'.
